exactTail.proof: ell<=floor(log2(b_(N+1)))-1 implies b_(N+1)*2^(-ell-1)>=1. For q>=2^(-ell-1), every n>=N+1 has b_n*q>=1 and all original cutoff derivatives vanish.

coverage.proof: The next lower endpoint is floor(log2(b_(N+1))), exactly one more than this upper endpoint, apart from the common ell0 maximum. Since b_n>=2^n, the upper endpoints tend to infinity.
